programmes.d: Sidney Fox swindled unmarried women and cashed stolen cheques while travelling the country. This eventually led to murder with the intention of claiming the victim's life insurance.
On Valentine's Day Paul Dyson strangled his partner Joanne Nelson to death before removing her body and making it look like she had just disappeared.
After Andre Genestin's wife discovered he had been cheating on her, he murdered her and stored her body in a car roof box in the garden.
Gritty series where crimes are solved using forensic techniques. When a lawyer was battered to death, the beating was so violent that the killer left microscopic evidence at the scene of the crime.
When two women from the same town are murdered in the same way, police fear a serial killer is on the loose. Tiny clues link them to the same man.
When a young woman was found dead on a golf course, the distinctive grass of the course would lead the investigation to her killer.

A teenage girl disappears one night, and her body was found a month later five kilometres from her home. Despite the murderer leaving very little evidence behind, the police have enough to tie him to the crime.
When a popular DJ is found murdered in a local garden, the cops race to find answers. With no other leads, the police turn to a blood spatter expert.
Robert Andrew and his wife Brenda were gunned down in their garage in an upscale neighbourhood in Oklahoma City. The forensic team hope to help find Robert's killer.

Three seemingly unrelated deaths proved to be serial murders. The killer had been careful as he used poison which had no taste or odour. Fortunately for investigators, it also had a unique chemical signature.

The victim was brutally murdered as he slept in his own bed. There are no foreign fingerprints in his home, but investigators find shoe impression in the mud outside and physical evidence they hope will lead them to the killer.
When Becky Watts disappeared the country was anxious for her return until police find her body. Soon stories don't add up and a computer history shows that evil lies close to home.

While John George Haigh was in prison for fraud, he came up with a plan for the perfect murder: if there was no body, how could he be charged for killing someone?
When Pierre LeGris reports his wife Rui Li missing, police are instantly wary. When they uncover a tangled web of loyalty and deception, it only adds to the suspicion.
The murder of a part-time actress triggers a nationwide manhunt for a killer. Whilst Neville Heath is on the run in Bournemouth, another woman is found dead.
Security guard Erwin Kastenberger was shot dead by armed robbers while he was delivering cash to a suburban bank in March 2005. Ron Iddles recounts being on scene that fateful afternoon.
In South Carolina's Lowcountry, a boat trip with friends turns into an unforgettable nightmare. It is a race against the elements to find a young woman who went overboard.
In South Carolina, a mother and son are shot and killed on their family's estate. Detectives collect evidence at the scene and the only witness is interviewed.
After Hurricane Ivan wreaks havoc in Alabama, a woman's charred remains are discovered. As police work to find her killer, the investigation stalls in the storm's aftermath.
A young newlywed reports a gust of wind tossed his wife overboard their honeymoon cruise. Investigators search the ocean through the night and find the bride's body.
Timothy Evans was hanged for murdering his wife and their baby daughter. Star witness for the prosecution was his landlord, John Christie of 10 Rillington Place.
With Evans hanged for a crime he did not commit, the local death toll of women was increasing. However, justice would eventually catch up with John Christie and an innocent man exonerated.
In 1992, Rachel Nickel was murdered on Wimbledon Common, after the biggest police manhunt in modern history, Colin Stagg was arrested and imprisoned for her murder.
The murder trial against Colin Stagg collapsed due to flawed police evidence. It would be 16 years before a breakthrough in DNA evidence would catch the real killer, Robert Napper.
Charlotte Pinkney vanished from Ilfracombe after going to a party. Police launched a murder hunt when her handbag was found in undergrowth - would they find the perpetrator?
An arrogant Bournemouth hotelier called Peter Taylor gets away with murdering his wife in 1982, but when he conspires to kill his son-in-law nine years later, his luck runs out.
When Danny Dyke tried playing the hardened drug dealer, he found himself in over his head, but it was his murderers that ended up having sleepless nights.
